instruction: Use the right arm to grab the small box for playingcards and move it outward.

source.instruction: Use the right arm to grab the small box for playingcards and move it outward.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the playingcards, which was at x = +8 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper above card box at (8, -12, 94) and orient downwards.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-23, +7, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -12, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Adjust yaw slightly to align with the box and lower toward grasp height to z=85.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -12, 85) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to grasp height (z=77.5) and close gripper to grasp the box.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the playingcards; closed the gripper (opening 0.72: holding the playingcards)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -12, 78) opening 0.72; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift box to z=88.5, transport outward along +x to x=38, and lower back to table height.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+30, +0, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (38, -12, 78) opening 0.72; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open right gripper to release the card box on the table.
